hikes.name: Mount Walker
hikes.blurb: A steady climb through rhododendrons to two viewpoints, one over the Olympics and one across Puget Sound to Rainier.

hikes.name: Fort Worden and Point Wilson
hikes.blurb: Past old coastal gun batteries on a bluff to a lighthouse where the Strait meets Puget Sound.

hikes.name: Green Mountain
hikes.blurb: Kitsap's best viewpoint, over the Sound to Seattle, Rainier and Baker.

hikes.name: Anderson Lake
hikes.blurb: From Milo Curry Trailhead, an 8.7-mile round trip to Anderson Lake, with about 750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Tibbals Lake
hikes.blurb: From USCG Parking, an 8.5-mile round trip to Tibbals Lake, with about 600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Dickerson Falls
hikes.blurb: From Lebers Lane Trailhead Parking Lot, a 2.3-mile round trip to Dickerson Falls, with about 300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Big Skidder Hill
hikes.blurb: From Discovery Bay Wildlife Area, a 9.9-mile round trip to the top of Big Skidder Hill (2,106 ft), with about 2,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mac's Pond
start: Fort Ward Park Upper Parking Lot
hikes.blurb: From Fort Ward Park Upper Parking Lot, a 5.4-mile round trip to Mac's Pond, with about 750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mt. Rainier viewpoint
start: Fort Ward Park Upper Parking Lot
hikes.blurb: From Fort Ward Park Upper Parking Lot, a 7.2-mile round trip to Mt. Rainier viewpoint, with about 800 feet of climbing.
